evidence: Real estate taxes: the book's own line "Real Estate Taxes" in Tax Revenue.
"Real Estate Tax Lien Proceeds": delinquent real estate tax collected through liens, so it is counted with the real estate tax.
Line "Earned Income Tax" in Tax Revenue.
Line "Local Services Tax" in Tax Revenue.
Line "Real Estate Transfer Tax" in Tax Revenue (a tax, not a transfer between funds).
Line "Payments in Lieu of Taxes" (PILOT) in Tax Revenue.
Line "ARPA Revenue Replacement": the one-time federal American Rescue Plan Act money used to replace lost revenue.
Line "Pension State Fund": the state's pension aid.
Line "Federal Reimb-Salaries": federal reimbursement of salaries.
Line "Lead Reimb - Salaries": lead program reimbursement of salaries.
Line "Federal Reimb-Fringes": federal reimbursement of benefits.
Line "Lead Reimb - Fringes": lead program reimbursement of benefits.
Line "Liquid Fuels Reimb.": the state's liquid fuels reimbursement.
Line "Anti-Auto Theft grant" and similar grants.
Line "Misc Grants & Gifts": grants and gifts.
